anomalies.observed: R34 (10k) is connected from the ATO valve MOSFET T8 gate to GND, forming a pull-down. The ATO predriver T3 is an NPN (BT3904) whose collector also pulls this gate low, so there is no path to pull the gate high.
anomalies.expected: The ATO low-side N-MOSFET gate should have a pull-up to +3V3, as on the main pump driver where R18 (10k) pulls T6 gate to +3V3. The predriver should invert the ESP32 control and allow the gate to rise when T3 is off.

evidence.quote: Main Pump & Valve Drivers, ATO Valve: R34 10k is between T8 gate and ground; T3 BT3904 collector drives the same gate.
Main Pump: R18 10k connects T6 gate to +3V3, showing the intended predriver pull-up topology.
T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch ... gate driven through R10 (100 Ω), pre-driven via T4 (BT3904).

anomalies.impact: The ATO valve MOSFET gate can never be driven high, so the ATO solenoid valve will not turn on. Automatic top-off would fail.

anomalies.observed: The ATO valve low-side switch is drawn as T8, part AO3400A, a small SOT-23 N-channel MOSFET.
anomalies.expected: The specification calls for an AON6407 8-DFN N-MOSFET for the ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch.

evidence.quote: Main Pump & Valve Drivers, ATO Valve: transistor reference T8, value/part AO3400A.
T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch

anomalies.impact: AO3400A has much lower current and thermal capability than the specified AON6407. Depending on solenoid current, the ATO driver may overheat or fail.

anomalies.observed: The ESP32-C6 IO2 pin is labeled NET0065, while the ATO predriver input at R49/T3 base is labeled NET0061. These are different net names with no drawn connection between them.
anomalies.expected: The ATO valve control from ESP32 IO2 should be the same net as the ATO predriver input, so that IO2 can drive T3.

evidence.quote: SoC block: ESP32-C6 pin IO2 is labeled NET0065.
Main Pump & Valve Drivers, ATO Valve: the input to R49/T3 base is labeled NET0061.

anomalies.impact: Even if the gate pull-down were corrected, the ESP32 IO2 signal would not reach the ATO predriver, so the ATO valve would remain uncontrollable.

parsed.summary: The ATO valve driver contains multiple deviations: R34 pulls the MOSFET gate down instead of up, the IO2 control net does not match the driver input net, and T8 is an AO3400A rather than the specified AON6407. These would prevent or impair ATO valve operation.
